intro: A severed raptor head serves as bloody proof of a beast slain in the Barrens. Gazrog of the Crossroads demands these macabre trophies to purge the local packs after an improbable theft of guard payroll.

p: Life in the arid plains of the Barrens is harsh enough without local wildlife raiding settlement towers. When a chest containing guard payroll vanished from the Crossroads watchtower, the defenders caught an improbable culprit red-handed: a wild raptor. Perplexed and furious, Gazrog placed an immediate bounty on the cunning reptiles prowling the savannah. Bringing severed raptor heads back to the outpost proves that these predatory pests are being culled before they can pilfer any more Horde supplies.
